annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley: Ley de Reforma Constitucional que establece el uso de la Inteligencia Artificial como uno de los principios de la administración de justicia
annotation.title_en: Bill: Constitutional Reform Law establishing the use of Artificial Intelligence as one of the principles of the administration of justice
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Congreso de la República del Perú (Congresista Jhakeline Katy Ugarte Mamani et al.)
annotation.venue: Congreso de la República del Perú
annotation.summary_en: Peruvian congressional bill (August 2023) proposing to amend Article 139 of the Constitution to add the use of artificial intelligence for resolving judicial cases and routine procedural actions as a principle of jurisdictional function. The explanatory memorandum cites Latin American judicial AI tools and argues for efficiency and access to justice.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Article 139 of the Peruvian Constitution by adding item 23 on AI use for judicial case resolution and routine procedural acts.
Aims to speed up judicial processes and give a constitutional framework for AI in justice.
Cites Prometea, VICTOR, PretorIA, Fiscal Watson and the Peruvian 'Justo' judicial assistant robot.
Claims AI decisions are not autonomous but follow human programming.
States no cost to the State; takes effect the day after publication.
